title: OSVVM test case settings, format version 0.1
description: The test case settings '<TestCaseFileName>_run.yml' OSVVM writes after a test case's simulation. Derived from OSVVM's writer 'WriteTestCaseSettingsYaml' in 'OsvvmScriptsCreateYamlReports.tcl' and reader 'ReportSimulate2Html.tcl'. Paths are relative to the build's directory, 'TestCaseFile' to 'ReportsTestSuiteDirectory'; an empty string means OSVVM wrote no such file.

TestCaseFile.description: VHDL source file of the test case: the last file analyzed before the simulation.

ScoreboardDict.description: Scoreboard report per scoreboard package instance.

TranscriptFiles.description: Transcripts of the test case, as a Tcl list.

TestCaseFileName.description: Base name of the test case's report files.

GenericNames.description: The generics' names and values, as appended to the test's name.

OsvvmSettingsInfo.description: OSVVM's settings: where it put the build's reports and logs. An empty string means OSVVM wrote no such file.

CoverageSubdirectory.description: The build's code coverage report file.
